message.name: WEAPON.TIMER
message.value: Timer is set by '1'-'5' keys.

message.name: AIR_CONTROL.NOTE
message.value: Use left/right keys to set the direction, where the strike is delivered.

message.name: BAZOOKA.DESCR
message.value: One of the basic weapons. Affected by the wind (especially, when shot with low power).

message.name: BAZOOKA.DAMAGE
message.value: 60 hp

message.name: GRENADE.DESCR
message.value: Standard grenade. It's quite easy to use as it's not affected by the wind.

message.name: GRENADE.DAMAGE
message.value: 60 hp

message.name: PNEUMATIC_DRILL.NAME
message.value: Pneumatic drill

message.name: PNEUMATIC_DRILL.DESCR
message.value: Drill is used to dig down vertical tunnels. Sometimes can be used to slightly injure a unit or drown them with kamikaze attack.

message.name: PNEUMATIC_DRILL.NOTE
message.value: Press SPACE to stop

message.name: PNEUMATIC_DRILL.DAMAGE
message.value: 5 hp per strike

message.name: BLOW_TORCH.DESCR
message.value: Allows you to dig tunnels under the ground. You can control the angle by up/down keys. Slightly injures and pushes any units it collides with.

message.name: BLOW_TORCH.DAMAGE
message.value: 4 hp per strike

message.name: DYNAMITE.DESCR
message.value: Detonates in 3 seconds after setup, leaving a large hole in the ground. Heavily pushes units.

message.name: DYNAMITE.DAMAGE
message.value: 75 hp

message.name: MINE.DESCR
message.value: Explodes in a second after any unit comes within its operating range. It can be used for defense, or as a source of additional damage. If there was no unit nearby while setting up a mine, the turn is not spent.

message.name: MINE.DAMAGE
message.value: 45 hp

message.name: RIFLE.DESCR
message.value: Simple but very useful weapon, makes 2 shots per turn. You may relocate your unit before making the second shot.

message.name: RIFLE.DAMAGE
message.value: 2 shots for 30 hp each

message.name: SHURIKEN.DESCR
message.value: Tricky missile weapon. You can throw 4 shurikens for one turn, you may relocate your unit between throws. The first direct hit on each distinct unit deals double damage.

message.name: SHURIKEN.NOTE
message.value: Most effective, when thrown at different units.

message.name: SHURIKEN.DAMAGE
message.value: 17 hp for the throw, 4 throws, the first direct hit at a target deals double damage.

message.name: CL_GRENADE.NAME
message.value: Cluster grenade

message.name: CL_GRENADE.DESCR
message.value: Cluster grenade, as a standard one, isn't affected by the wind. It does major damage by its fragments. It's very effective in enclosed space.

message.name: CL_GRENADE.DAMAGE
message.value: 40 hp from explosion, 8 fragments for 15 hp each.

message.name: UZI.DESCR
message.value: Simple but effective gun. Shoots with short bursts, almost no disperse. Can be controlled while shooting.

message.name: UZI.NOTE
message.value: While shooting you can change the angle of the weapon by 'up/down' keys.

message.name: UZI.DAMAGE
message.value: 16 bullets for 5 hp each

message.name: MORTAR.DESCR
message.value: Weapon, similar to bazooka. The initial speed can't be regulated. A missile isn't affected by the wind. In explosion releases several fragments.

message.name: MORTAR.DAMAGE
message.value: 35 hp from explosion, 5 fragments for 25 hp each

message.name: STICKY_GRENADE.NAME
message.value: Sticky grenade

message.name: STICKY_GRENADE.DESCR
message.value: Sticky grenade adheres to any surface. In explosion releases several explosive fragments, which are not influenced by the wind and flit to the air.

message.name: STICKY_GRENADE.DAMAGE
message.value: 40 hp for explosion, 7 fragments for 20 hp each

message.name: SHOTGUN.DESCR
message.value: Powerful close combat weapon. In competent hands it can tear any units to pieces. It shoots with 7 widely spreading pellets. Each pellet disappears after short distance.

message.name: SHOTGUN.DAMAGE
message.value: 7 pellets for 13 hp each

message.name: SHEEP.DESCR
message.value: Starts moving in the pointed direction but can turn around if struck into an obstacle or try to jump it over.

message.name: SHEEP.NOTE
message.value: Press SPACE to explode a swine at any moment.

message.name: SHEEP.DAMAGE
message.value: 90 hp

message.name: SUPER_SHEEP.DESCR
message.value: A controllable flying boar. It starts flying upwards when launched and explodes when bumps into the ground or any unit. Boar explodes if the unit who launched it takes damage.

message.name: SUPER_SHEEP.NOTE
message.value: To control a boar use left/right arrows.

message.name: SUPER_SHEEP.DAMAGE
message.value: 90 hp

message.name: MINIGUN.DESCR
message.value: A powerful and fast-firing weapon, capable of dealing great damage. However, it's rather inaccurate, so use it on close or middle range.

message.name: MINIGUN.DAMAGE
message.value: 20 bullets for 6 hp each

message.name: CARPET_BAZOOKA.NAME
message.value: Cat bazooka

message.name: CARPET_BAZOOKA.DESCR
message.value: Shoots a cat, which bounces several times in a random direction upon hitting units or ground. Unpredictable weapon, which may deal large damage to either an enemy or a teammate.

message.name: CARPET_BAZOOKA.DAMAGE
message.value: 50 hp, 2 extra bounces

message.name: DRILL.NAME
message.value: Drill rocket

message.name: DRILL.DESCR
message.value: A missile, which can get a unit hiding under the ground or behind an obstacle! It is influenced by the wind.

message.name: DRILL.DAMAGE
message.value: 60 hp

message.name: SHOCKER.DESCR
message.value: Close combat weapon based on the direct impact of electric charge on the biological target. Tosses up units. Tossed up units take fall damage, damage value is dependent of the falling speed.

message.name: SHOCKER.NOTE
message.value: Tosses up damaged unit. Even more effective if you manage to hit several targets.

message.name: SHOCKER.DAMAGE
message.value: 40 hp + fall damage

message.name: GUIDING_BAZOOKA.NAME
message.value: Homing missile

message.name: GUIDING_BAZOOKA.DESCR
message.value: A missile that goes for a target by the shortest flight path. It fits perfectly for long distances.

message.name: GUIDING_BAZOOKA.NOTE
message.value: Mark the target by the double mouse click, then adjust direction and power just as for regular bazooka.

message.name: GUIDING_BAZOOKA.DAMAGE
message.value: 60 hp

message.name: CANNON.NAME
message.value: Vintage cannon

message.name: CANNON.DESCR
message.value: Shoots a cannon ball that detonates only after full stop. The shot power is not regulated. Attacking unit cannot move away after using the cannon.

message.name: CANNON.DAMAGE
message.value: 90 hp

message.name: TELE_THROWER.NAME
message.value: Portable teleport

message.name: TELE_THROWER.DESCR
message.value: Allows the user to relocate to the place, where the teleport happened to stop after a toss. Throw it just like a common grenade. If launched into tide space, can destroy some ground and deal light damage to units nearby. Teleport is destroyed if thrown into water, unless unit has water breath.

message.name: TELE_THROWER.NOTE
message.value: It can be used several times during a turn. Relocation doesn't spend a turn.

message.name: SWITCH_TURN.NAME
message.value: Turn switcher

message.name: SWITCH_TURN.DESCR
message.value: Passes the turn to another teammate.

message.name: SWITCH_TURN.NOTE
message.value: Use the left/right keys for switching between your team members. Use the SPACE key to choose a unit.

message.name: SPIDER.DESCR
message.value: Spider mine crawls up to an enemy and stands on it. If the enemy moves out, the spider will detonate immediately, dealing severe damage and poisoning the target for 10 turns. Spider will explode in 6 sec after moving starts, if there's no enemy on its way. If target uses any sort of teleportation, spider can teleport as well.

message.name: SPIDER.NOTE
message.value: The poison deals damage equal to 5% of the current hp at the end of each turn. Poison can be cured by any medkit. Doesn't damage units with less than 20 hp

message.name: SPIDER.DAMAGE
message.value: 65 hp

message.name: FIREWORK.DESCR
message.value: Always flies upward, drilling through everything on its way. If it comes across a unit, firework will carry it to the sky. Units can take fall damage, dependent on falling speed,

message.name: FIREWORK.NOTE
message.value: It can be used to knock down the enemy, which stands above you.

message.name: FIREWORK.DAMAGE
message.value: 20 hp from impaling, 50 hp from explosion + fall damage

message.name: MOLOTOV.NAME
message.value: Molotov cocktail

message.name: MOLOTOV.DESCR
message.value: Launched as a grenade. It detonates when it contacts the ground or unit, covering surroundings with flaming mixture.

message.name: MOLOTOV.DAMAGE
message.value: 40 hp out of explosion, fire damage 30 hp per second

message.name: FIRE_THROWER.DESCR
message.value: Throws streams of a burning napalm, which smolders on the ground for some time.

message.name: FIRE_THROWER.DAMAGE
message.value: 12 drops for 3 hp each, fire damage: 30 hp per second

message.name: NAPALM.NAME
message.value: Napalm strike

message.name: NAPALM.DESCR
message.value: Strikes with bombs that deal minor damage and ignite the ground.

message.name: NAPALM.DAMAGE
message.value: 5 rockets for 20 hp each, fire damage 30 hp per second

message.name: AIR_STRIKE.NAME
message.value: Air strike

message.name: AIR_STRIKE.DESCR
message.value: Drops 5 rockets at the pointed target. Rockets are not influenced by the wind.

message.name: AIR_STRIKE.DAMAGE
message.value: 5 rockets for 50 hp each.

message.name: METEOR.DESCR
message.value: Calls a devastating meteorite upon the earth. Meteorite falls on the ground at the random angle, on impact it breaks into 4 fragments.

message.name: METEOR.DAMAGE
message.value: 65 hp from main meteorite, 4 fragments for 35 hp each

message.name: CARPET_STRIKE.NAME
message.value: Cat strike

message.name: CARPET_STRIKE.DESCR
message.value: Strikes with 3 infernal cats into the pointed target. Cats are not influenced by the wind. When hitting the ground, cats bounce to the random direction.

message.name: CARPET_STRIKE.DAMAGE
message.value: 3 cats, 2 bounces, 50 hp of damage from every strike

message.name: WATERMELON.NAME
message.value: Watermelon bomb

message.name: WATERMELON.DESCR
message.value: An extremely powerful type of a cluster grenade. When exploding, watermelon breaks into 6 smaller fragments, which explode on contacting the ground.

message.name: WATERMELON.DAMAGE
message.value: 80 hp from exlosion, 6 slices for 50 hp each

message.name: HOLY_GRENADE.NAME
message.value: Demonic grenade

message.name: HOLY_GRENADE.DESCR
message.value: Very powerful grenade. Explodes only after full stop. Attacking unit cannot move away after using it.

message.name: HOLY_GRENADE.DAMAGE
message.value: 115 hp

message.name: SLEDGEHAMMER.DESCR
message.value: The most powerful strike, it drives any target to depression, taking the 35% of their current hit points (but damage cannot exceed 280 hp and be less than 60 hp) and burying them in the ground. Instantly destroys most stationary objects.

message.name: SLEDGEHAMMER.DAMAGE
message.value: 35% of target's current health, but not less than 60 hp and not greater than 280 hp

message.name: TELEPORT.DESCR
message.value: Allows the unit to shift to any area, and even under the ground. Does small damage near the target point. Spends a turn.

message.name: TELEPORT.NOTE
message.value: To relocate double click on the desired point.

message.name: JETPACK.DESCR
message.value: Personal super light flying device, it lets you rise above the battlefield with the help of jet thrust.

message.name: JETPACK.NOTE
message.value: Remember, fuel is limited! After flying around you can switch to another weapon.

message.name: ROPE.DESCR
message.value: A rope that can help you to climb up any obstacle.

message.name: ROPE.NOTE
message.value: Moving around with a rope doesn't spend a turn.

message.name: HARPOON.NAME
message.value: Electric harpoon

message.name: HARPOON.DESCR
message.value: Hooks up and pulls a unit to the attacker, doing damage by electricity while dragging.

message.name: HARPOON.DAMAGE
message.value: 30 hp when hits a target, then 11 shocks for 10 hp each every 0.25s

message.name: BAT.DESCR
message.value: A unit attacked by this weapon, is sent flying with a very high speed. Ideal to push enemies into the water.

message.name: BAT.DAMAGE
message.value: 40 hp

message.name: KALASH.DESCR
message.value: A decent and reliable weapon. It shots with bursts, one bullet can hit 2 enemies. Bullets can slightly push frozen units. You can move between bursts.

message.name: KALASH.DAMAGE
message.value: 2 bursts with 4 bullets, each bullet deals 16 hp of damage

message.name: GIRDER.DESCR
message.value: Strategic utility. Girders can be used as bridges, ladders or defensive constructions. Placing the girder doesn't waste your turn.

message.name: GIRDER.NOTE
message.value: Cannot be placed on the ground or near the units and other objects, as well as when other units are in motion.

message.name: PROJECTOR_DRONE.DESCR
message.value: Creates a clone that lures AI units within a small radius onto itself. You can choose clone using Turn switcher and attack with it using most of weapons from your arsenal. Can be placed only when there are AI units in radius. Clone lasts for 10 turns. Doesn't waste a turn!

dictionary.message: Place the hologram between you and the enemies – bots will hit only it. Pass the turn to it and attack without moving. Lasts 10 turns, invulnerable, not counted as a living unit.

message.name: FREEZER.NAME
message.value: Freezing bazooka

message.name: FREEZER.DESCR
message.value: Shoots special missile which freezes units within area of effect for 2 turns. Missile is affected by the wind.

message.name: FREEZER.DAMAGE
message.value: 40 hp

message.name: FREEZER.NOTE
message.value: Frozen players cannot move, jump or use the rope for 2 turns. Ice block can be melted by fire or shattered by dealing 160 damage.

message.name: CROSSBOW.DESCR
message.value: Crossbow shoots for two times per turn, for 5 poisonous bolts in each shot, which are heavily affected by the wind. Each bolt poisons units for 10 turns. You can move between shots.

message.name: CROSSBOW.NOTE
message.value: The poison deals damage equal to 5% of the current hit points at the end of each turn. Poison can be cured by any medkit. Doesn't deal any damage if the unit has 20 hp or less remaining.

message.name: CROSSBOW.DAMAGE
message.value: 2 shots, 5 bolts for 7 hp each

message.name: FREEZING_MINE.NAME
message.value: Freezing mine

message.name: FREEZING_MINE.DESCR
message.value: Special mine that instantly freezes any unit who dares to approach it for 2 turns. If there was no unit nearby while setting up a mine, the turn is not spent.

message.name: FREEZING_MINE.DAMAGE
message.value: 25 hp

message.name: FREEZING_MINE.NOTE
message.value: Frozen players cannot move, jump or use the rope for 2 turns. Ice block can be melted by fire or shattered by dealing 160 damage.

message.name: GROUNDBREAKER.NAME
message.value: Fougasse rocket

message.name: GROUNDBREAKER.DESCR
message.value: Rocket stuffed with devastating shards that cause minor damage but destroy lots of landmass. Affected by the wind.

message.name: GROUNDBREAKER.DAMAGE
message.value: 50 hp from explosion, 10 shards for 10 hp each

message.name: BUNKER_BUSTER.DESCR
message.value: Special missile that digs the way down and detonates once it encounters any unit or reaches the water. When drilling ignites the ground. Instantly detonates upon approaching water.

message.name: BUNKER_BUSTER.DAMAGE
message.value: 40 hp out of explosion, fire damage 30 hp per second

message.name: SUPER_BUNKER_BUSTER.NAME
message.value: Super bunkerbuster

message.name: SUPER_BUNKER_BUSTER.DESCR
message.value: Special missile that digs the way down and detonates once it encounters any unit or reaches the water. When drilling ignites the ground. Instantly detonates upon approaching water. Launches 6 drilling shards upon explosion, which heavily destroy the ground.

message.name: SUPER_BUNKER_BUSTER.DAMAGE
message.value: 50 hp + 6 shards for 30 hp each, fire damage 30 hp per second

message.name: GUARDING_BOT.NAME
message.value: Guarding bot

message.name: GUARDING_BOT.DESCR
message.value: Defensive device, jumps into the air when enemy approaches and attacks it with electric bullets which ignore force fields. Can be triggered only by enemies standing on the ground. If there was no unit nearby while installing the guardian, the turn is not spent.

message.name: GUARDING_BOT.DAMAGE
message.value: 10 electric bullets, 3 hp each

message.name: TITANIUM_GIRDER.NAME
message.value: Titanium girder

message.name: TITANIUM_GIRDER.DESCR
message.value: Absolutely indestructible barrier, no weapon can damage it.

message.name: DISC_LAUNCHER.NAME
message.value: Disc launcher

message.name: DISC_LAUNCHER.DESCR
message.value: Shoots with sharp discs, which bounce from any obstacle. Disc explodes when it hits a unit or makes 4 bounces. Each bounce increases disc damage.

message.name: DISC_LAUNCHER.DAMAGE
message.value: 50 hp + 20 hp for each bounce, up to 4 bounces

message.name: HOPPING_BAZOOKA.NAME
message.value: Jumping grenade

message.name: HOPPING_BAZOOKA.DESCR
message.value: Nice choice for long distances. When you press SPACE while grenade is flying, it jumps up, and its damage increases. You can do up to 3 jumps.

message.name: HOPPING_BAZOOKA.DAMAGE
message.value: 40 hp + 30 hp for each jump, up to 3 jumps

message.name: HELICOPTER.NAME
message.value: RC helicopter

message.name: HELICOPTER.DESCR
message.value: It's now possible to attack units or destroy ground without leaving your hideout! Helicopter carries 4 bombs. Press SPACE, to drop them. If you press SPACE after using all of your bombs, helicopter falls and explodes. Picking a weapon crate with helicopter gives it an additional bomb and extra fuel. Helicopter explodes from any explosions nearby or when it's owner takes damage.

message.name: HELICOPTER.DAMAGE
message.value: 30 hp from explosion, 25 hp from each bomb

message.name: UFO.NAME
message.value: Flying saucer

message.name: UFO.DESCR
message.value: Saucer is able to pick up and carry all kinds of mines: fly above the mine, press E or SPACE to capture it, then press E or SPACE again to release. If you press SPACE above the enemy, saucer falls on them end explodes. saucer explodes if the unit who launched it takes damage.

message.name: UFO.DAMAGE
message.value: 80 hp

message.name: ANTIFREEZE.DESCR
message.value: Removes ice from the user and protects them from freezing and slowing for 2 of their turns (only turns that are started by them are counted). Also heals 50 hp. Spends a turn!

message.name: FORCE_FIELD.NAME
message.value: Force field

message.name: FORCE_FIELD.DESCR
message.value: Force field generator which repels most kinds of ammo. Lasts for 10 turns.

message.name: CIRCUS_CANNON.NAME
message.value: Circus cannon

message.name: CIRCUS_CANNON.DESCR
message.value: Shoots with your unit at large distance. When the unit hits the ground, a large explosion happens. Your unit also takes 1/3 of the explosion damage.

message.name: CIRCUS_CANNON.DAMAGE
message.value: 120 hp, and 40 hp shooting fighter

message.name: BOOMERANG.DESCR
message.value: When boomerang hits a unit or the ground, it bounces at your direction, you may try to catch it and throw again. For the second throw, boomerang won't bounce. Greatly affected by the wind.

message.name: BOOMERANG.DAMAGE
message.value: 65 hp per strike

message.name: EMERGENCY_TELEPORT.NAME
message.value: Emergency teleport

message.name: EMERGENCY_TELEPORT.DESCR
message.value: Instantly transfers unit to a random point at a middle range. Doesn't waste a turn. Can be used in the air. If cannot find valid destination point for a reasonable amount of time, unit is teleported to the same place.

dictionary.message: Use the emergency teleport to get out of enclosed spaces without wasting a turn.

message.name: BANDAGE.DESCR
message.value: Heals half of the damage received on previous and current turns. Can cure bleeding. Each unit can be bandaged only once! Doesn't waste a turn.

dictionary.message: It's wise to use bandage to counter enemy's combo, which dealt you a considerable damage.

message.name: GRAVITY_GUN.NAME
message.value: Gravity gun

message.name: GRAVITY_GUN.DESCR
message.value: You can do 2 shots per turn, each of them pushes units in air. If you shoot under your feet, you launch up in air without taking any damage. You can move between shots.

message.name: GRAVITY_GUN.DAMAGE
message.value: 2 shots for 20 hp each

message.name: GRAVITY_GUN.HINT
message.value: Despite low damage, a lucky shot can push your enemy far away. If you manage to hit the enemy while they are in the air, they definitely fly into the water!

message.name: THUNDERBOLT.DESCR
message.value: Thunderbolt launches the lightning, that explodes upon contact with units or ground. Releases additional lightnings upon explosion into enemy units in large radius, which ignore ground and does not do knockback. Main lightning is affected by the wind. Shooter slightly pushed backwards upon releasing lightning.

message.name: THUNDERBOLT.DAMAGE
message.value: 95 hp from main lightning, 70 hp from additional ones

message.name: THUNDERBOLT.HINT
message.value: Great against grouped enemies or units standing near the wall.

message.name: BARRIER.NAME
message.value: Laser barrier

message.name: BARRIER.DESCR
message.value: Special generators that stick to any ground and create barries between themselves in small radius. Your enemy will suffer damage and lose their turn, if they pass through the beam. Beams don't affect your team members. Doesn't waste a turn.

message.name: BARRIER.DAMAGE
message.value: 10 hp

message.name: BARRIER.HINT
message.value: Barriers do little damage, though they are perfect for defense!

message.name: ANTITOXIN.DESCR
message.value: Restores 15 hp for 6 turns. Poison does no damage to you, while you're under antitoxin effect. Each unit can be affected antitoxin only once! Doesn't waste a turn.

dictionary.message: Use antitoxin to prevent massive poison damage. Try to find a medkit, while you're protected.

message.name: ATOMIC_BOMB.NAME
message.value: Atomic bomb

message.name: ATOMIC_BOMB.DESCR
message.value: Places a special mark on the map without spending a turn. On your next turn a bomb will be dropped at this mark. The bomb emits several explosions to the sides of epicenter. Units at the epicenter are poisoned for 10 turns.

message.name: ATOMIC_BOMB.DAMAGE
message.value: 80 hp + 6 explosions for 50 hp each.

message.name: ATOMIC_BOMB.HINT
message.value: This bomb is a powerful weapon, capable to destroy or sink several enemies. Your enemy has a vision of the mark – so make sure they won't be able to leave their position before explosion!

message.name: GAS_GRENADE.NAME
message.value: Gas grenade

message.name: GAS_GRENADE.DESCR
message.value: Gas grenade emits a cloud on explosion, which deals poison damage to all units it covers at the end of a turn. Cloud lasts for 6 turns, and its lifetime can be increased by Poison duration parameter in thrower's equipment. Poisonong parameter in targets' equipment protects them from taking damage for the corresponding amount of cloud's last turns.

message.name: GAS_GRENADE.DAMAGE
message.value: 50 hp of poison damage, capped at 60 hp

message.name: GAS_GRENADE.HINT
message.value: Can be used to force the enemy to change their position. Great against frozen targets. Remember, cloud damages your units as well!

dictionary.message: Use up/down keys to change angle. Press and hold space to adjust power. Mind the wind!

Grenade is a good choice, when opponent stands in a crater at large distance. Change angle with up/down keys. Adjust power by holding the SPACE key. Grenade is not affected by the wind and explodes on full stop.
Pneumatic drill is irreplaceable if you choose Kamikaze tactics. Stand near your opponent and make a tunnel. If you are lucky, your opponent will fall down. Press SPACE to use.
There are two ways to use drill: to make your way through the obstacle or to push your opponent to the water. Press SPACE to use. You may change angle with up/down keys while moving.
Dynamite deals great damage and is good to send your opponents to the water. When dynamite is set, you have only few seconds to run away. Press SPACE to set.
Mine doesn't end the turn, if there are no units nearby . So, set up the mine and push your opponent on it for extra damage. Press SPACE to set.
Rifle is good to push your opponents to the water or on the mine. Change angle with up/down keys. Press SPACE to shoot.
You may toss 4 shurikens per turn. To deal maximum damage, try to hit different opponents. Change angle with up/down keys. Press SPACE to throw.

The best way to use cluster grenade is to throw it to an opponent standing in a deeping. Change angle with up/down keys. Adjust power by holding the SPACE key. Grenade is not affected by the wind and explodes on full stop.
Uzi deals good damage and can be used to push several opponents off the ground in one turn. Change angle with up/down keys, you can adjust angle even while shooting!. Press SPACE to use.
Mortar is a reliable, predictable weapon with constant power. It does more damage with high angles. Adjust angle with up/down keys. Press SPACE to shoot.
Sticky grenade has a large coverage area and deals great damage in enclosed space. Change angle with up/down keys. Adjust power by holding the SPACE key.
Shotgun is great at close combat. Change angle with up/down keys. Press SPACE to shoot.
Turn in desired direction and prace SPACE to launch. You can manually explode a swine at any moment by pressing SPACE again. But remember, that swines are unpredictable!
Press SPACE to launch. You can control the boar during the flight by left/right keys.
Minigun deals great damage, but has a low accuracy of fire, so it's better used at short distances. Adjust angle with up/down keys. Press SPACE to shoot.
It's a good idea to shoot cats at large distances to avoid occasional ricochet hits. Change angle with up/down keys. Adjust power by holding the SPACE key.
Drill rocket comes to help when your enemies are hiding deep under ground. Change angle with up/down keys. Adjust power by holding the SPACE key. Mind the wind!
Shocker is a great weapon for throwing your enemies into the water. Stand next to your opponent and press SPACE to use. Remember that the effect is even greater if you manage to hit multiple targets.
First, double click on the map to set the mark. Then change angle with up/down keys. Adjust initial power with SPACE key.
You cannot move after shooting from cannon, so wisely choose the location. Change angle with up/down keys. Press SPACE to shoot.
Be careful, as portable teleport bounces from the ground and thus may trigger far from desired location .Change angle with up/down keys. Adjust power by holding SPACE key.
The timer doesn't stop while you're selecting the unit, so decide quickly. Pick a unit with left/right keys. Press SPACE to select.
Don't stand near the opponent which has a spider under them – you may receive serious damage when they move. Press SPACE to launch.
Use the firework to hit an enemy above, no matter how much ground is between you. Press SPACE to set.
Sniper rifle is much less effective in close combat, so shoot only from large distance. Adjust angle with up/down keys. Press SPACE to shoot.
Molotov is a very powerful weapon. Best used against opponents in a deeping. Change angle with up/down keys. Adjust power by holding SPACE key.
Firethrower deals maximum damage, when opponent cannot drop off burning area. Adjust angle with up/down keys. Press SPACE to shoot. Mind the wind!
Change direction of attack with left/right keys. To launch the napalm just double click on the map. Make sure that the enemies won't easily drop off the fire.
Airstrike is good against group of enemies. Change direction of attack with left/right keys. Double click on the map to launch.
Use meteorite on open ground only, as the angle of attack is determined randomly. Double click on the map to attack.

Cat strike is effective against large groups of enemies. Change direction of attack with left/right keys. Double click on the map to launch. Remember that this weapon is very powerful, but unpredictable.

Watermelon has a tremendous power! It's heavier than regular grenade, flies not so far and bounces from the ground. Change angle with up/down keys. Adjust power by holding SPACE key. Remember, you have 5 seconds to run away!
You cannot move after throwing demon grenade, so wisely choose the location. Change angle with up/down keys. Adjust power by holding SPACE key.
Sledgehammer literally nail your opponent down to the ground. You just have to use some fire weapon on your next turn. Stand in front of the enemy and press SPACE to hit.
Teleports your unit to any point on the map. Use it when there are no other ways to escape. Just double click on desired location to use.
Keep in mind, that the fuel is limited and turn timer is ticking. Press SPACE to take off. Use arrow keys to control the flight. Press SPACE again to land.
Rope is used to access the high ground. Change angle with up/down keys. Press SPACE to use.
Harpoon is useful when there is a water or a mine between you and your enemy, you can pull your opponent right there. Change angle with up/down keys. Press SPACE to use
Bat is the best way to send your enemy into a long flight straight to the water. Change angle with up/down keys. Stand in front of the enemy and press SPACE to hit.
Extremly effective in close combat. Change angle with up/down keys. Press SPACE to shoot.
Use the girder to protect units that can be easily pushed to the water. Double click on the map to set up. Change angle with up/down keys.
Freezer will immobilize enemies that don't have jetpack or portable teleport. Change angle with up/down keys. Adjust power by holding SPACE key. Mind the wind!
Crossbow is useful at the beginning of the combat against high-level armored enemies. Change angle with up/down keys. Press SPACE to shoot. Mind the wind!
Unlike regular mine, freezing mine triggers immediately. Great in combination with other mines. Press SPACE to set up.
Fougasse destroys huge land masses. Be careful, as it is rather unpredictable. Change angle with up/down keys. Adjust power by holding SPACE key. Mind the wind!
Bunker buster is the most effective weapon agains opponents hidden underground. Double click on the map to launch.
Super bunker buster just tears the ground into pieces! Double click on the map to launch.
Guardian is a device that protects you from opponents that decide to come close to you. Press SPACE to set.
Titanium girder is especially useful to protect yourself or to block your opponent. Double click on the map to set up. Change angle with up/down keys.

Disc launcher has good chances to deal massive damage, if you use it against enemy group in enclosed space. Be careful – discs move very fast, and it's hard to dodge your own disc if it bounces in your direction.
Effective on medium and large distances, when you can perform at least 2 jumps. Change angle with up/down keys. Adjust power by holding SPACE key.
Use space key to drop bombs. Don't forget that helicopter deals additional damage with its explosion. If you accidently injure the controlling character, helicopter instantly goes down.
You can use saucer to drag aside enemy's guardians, or take the mines lying on the ground for additional damage. To deal direct damage, place saucer above the enemy and press space.
Even if antifreeze makes you to spend a turn, it's still the best move against ice users.
Force field provides good protection against most ammo, but its power may not be enough to deflect bullets or accelerated air strike.
Great for using by revived zombies and nearly dead units, as it is the easy way to inflict large amounts of damage.
Boomerang's bounce depends on the wind force and throw power. If you don't manage to catch the boomerang, it explodes with the next impact, dealing only half damage.

message.name: NEGATOR.NAME
message.value: Heal blocker

message.name: NEGATOR.DESCR
message.value: Device that can be attached to any surface, which disables common healing methods for your enemy. Doesn't affect healing from most bosses' abilities. Only halves Rabbit regenetation via their carrots. If an enemy destroys the blocker, they get considerable damage. Lasts for 6 turns.

message.name: NEGATOR.DAMAGE
message.value: 75 hp to enemy destroyer

message.name: NEGATOR.HINT
message.value: Heal blocker should be used to counter enemy, who relies too much on medkits and regeneration. Use it, when an enemy digs under the ground to heal. Make sure enemy can't destroy the blocker with mines, try to attach it to high walls or ceiling.

message.name: PARASITE.DESCR
message.value: Paraiste is thrown like a normal grenade, but it latches to enemy instead of exploding. On the next turn parasite will slow its victim and then explode in 10 seconds.

message.name: PARASITE.DAMAGE
message.value: 40 hp on latch, 40 hp more when triggered

message.name: PARASITE.HINT
message.value: Parasite damage isn't the greatest, but its main purpose is to trouble your opponent on their next turn. Keep in mind that your enemy may use the turn switch to avoid the effect of the parasite.

message.name: BANNER_NAME_1
message.value: Clan banner

message.name: BANNER_NAME_2
message.value: Battle banner

message.name: BANNER_NAME_3
message.value: Honorable banner

message.name: BANNER_NAME_4
message.value: Champion banner

message.name: BANNER_NAME_5
message.value: Victory banner

message.name: BANNER_DESCRIPTION_1
message.value: The troops get +6 to attack and armor while near the banner.

message.name: BANNER_DESCRIPTION_2
message.value: The troops get +8 to attack and armor and +5 to regeneration while near the banner.

message.name: BANNER_DESCRIPTION_3
message.value: All troops on the battlefield get a speed bonus. Troops also get +8 to attack and armor and +5 to regeneration while near the banner.

message.name: BANNER_DESCRIPTION_4
message.value: All troops on the battlefield get a speed bonus and +5% to vampirism. Troops also get +8 to attack and armor and +5 to regeneration while near the banner.

message.name: BANNER_DESCRIPTION_5
message.value: All troops on the battlefield get a speed bonus and +5% to vampirism. Troops also get +10 to attack and armor and +5 to regeneration while near the banner.

message.name: BLIZZARD.DESCR
message.value: Fires 5 ice projectiles that go through any surface. The main projectile goes in a straight line, while the others follow close behind, periodically converging in one point. Some projectiles have increased speed. These projectiles freeze units for 2 turns.

message.name: BLIZZARD.DAMAGE
message.value: 5 ice shards for 45 hp each

message.name: BLIZZARD.HINT
message.value: Hitting the target with extra projectiles may be hard to perform, but if you evaluate convergence point, you can deal high damage towards enemy.

message.name: VILE_PUMPKIN.NAME
message.value: Vile pumpkin

message.name: VILE_PUMPKIN.DESCR
message.value: Ugly, filthy and absolutely useless pumpkin. Throw it into your enemy and it will replace their precious hat for 6 turns! While enemy wears pumpkin, they take small damage every turn. Use wisely against bosses, as it only works against them for 2 turns. If pumpkin hits enemy who is already wearing pumpkin, it explodes, dealing slightly increased damage.

message.name: VILE_PUMPKIN.DAMAGE
message.value: 13 hp for 6 turns, 45 hp explosion damage

message.name: VILE_PUMPKIN.HINT
message.value: That's easy: use pumpkin on the enemy with the strongest hat.

message.name: DARK_PACT.NAME
message.value: Witchcraft potion

message.name: DARK_PACT.DESCR
message.value: After using this potion, your unit will be saved from the water. Also your unit gets 10 armor. Once your unit is saved, the protection fades away. But this power has its price – you'll have to pay 30% of your unit's full hit points, 20% for activation and 10% when triggered. Can be used 1 time per battle.

dictionary.message: Remember that you get the water protection only on the next turn! Don't try to sacrifice your own unit to drown the enemy!

message.name: SOUL_GUN.DESCR
message.value: Releases swarm of hungry spirits towards a target. Spirits pick random ally or enemy unit in a small cone and rush through the ground to it. Damage of spirits increases, if the weapon user is wounded. If a spirit doesn't find a target, it attacks the user!

message.name: SOUL_GUN.DAMAGE
message.value: 16 souls for 4 hp to 8 hp each depending on the shooter's health

message.name: SOUL_GUN.HINT
message.value: Just aim towards an enemy and shoot. Make sure there are no allies in the area of effect.

message.name: SNOWBALL.DESCR
message.value: Snowball rolls on a ground, gathering all units it meets. Damage is increased with distance! After 4 seconds the snowball explodes. Great weapon to bury whole group of enemies! Snowball speed decreases with every gathered unit.

message.name: SNOWBALL.DAMAGE
message.value: 1-60 hp when rolling over, 60 hp explosion damage

message.name: SNOWBALL.HINT
message.value: Snowball grants dozens of ways to sink your enemies. Keep trying!

message.name: DEEP_FREEZE.NAME
message.value: Deep freeze

message.name: DEEP_FREEZE.DESCR
message.value: Lowers the ground temperature, dealing severe damage to all units. The more landmass is around a unit, the more damage it gets.

message.name: DEEP_FREEZE.DAMAGE
message.value: 15 hp from every snowflake, up to 8 snowflakes for each target

message.name: DEEP_FREEZE.HINT
message.value: Use it to finish off your enemies, especially when they are hiding underground.

message.name: FIREWORK_BARREL.NAME
message.value: Firework barrel

message.name: FIREWORK_BARREL.DESCR
message.value: A real long-range artillery! Barrel shoots 6 rockets into the sky, which then fall and aim on random enemies. Ineffective in enclosed spaces!

message.name: FIREWORK_BARREL.DAMAGE
message.value: 6 rockets for 40 hp each

message.name: FIREWORK_BARREL.HINT
message.value: Deals good damage if your enemies are on the open space.

message.name: GIFT_BOX.NAME
message.value: Gift box

message.name: GIFT_BOX.DESCR
message.value: Gift box is set like a regular mine and, when triggered, replaces unit's hat and artifact! On next turn the box disappears and affected unit gets random hat and artifact, chosen from the pool consisting of equipment you can buy in the Shop. Can be used on allies.

dictionary.message: Versatile utility: push an enemy with a good hat on it or try to get better equipment for yourself with it.

message.name: ARTILLERY.DESCR
message.value: Artillery shoots 6 homing missiles at 45 degrees at the given point. Rockets deal high damage and devastate the landscape greatly!

message.name: ARTILLERY.DAMAGE
message.value: 6 rockets for 50 hp each.

message.name: ARTILLERY.HINT
message.value: Double-click to set the point where you'd like to launch the missiles and press SPACE to place the artillery on the ground.

message.name: STICKY_MINE.NAME
message.value: Sticky mine

message.name: STICKY_MINE.DESCR
message.value: A perfect tool for saboteurs. Attaches to any surface, then acts as a common mine. If there was no unit nearby while setting up a mine, the turn is not spent.

message.name: STICKY_MINE.DAMAGE
message.value: 40 hp

message.name: STICKY_MINE.HINT
message.value: You can throw sticky mine like any other missile – adjust the power by holding SPACE.

message.name: LASER_GUN.NAME
message.value: Laser rifle

message.name: LASER_GUN.DESCR
message.value: Laser beam easily cuts through both ground and living creatures! The beam can be controlled by up/down keys.

message.name: LASER_GUN.DAMAGE
message.value: 32 hits for 3 hp each

message.name: LASER_GUN.HINT
message.value: Laser can be as great for drowning as for damage.

message.name: BOULDER.DESCR
message.value: A huge boulder, which tumbles chaotically over the map! Throws units into the air, dealing damage depending on boulder's speed. Ignores force field.

message.name: BOULDER.DAMAGE
message.value: depends on boulder speed

message.name: BOULDER.HINT
message.value: Even though it's hard to calculate, you can deal guaranteed damage, if you throw the boulder strictly down at the enemy. Girders may help to create enclosed space for greater damage.

message.name: VACUUM_GRENADE.NAME
message.value: Vacuum grenade

message.name: VACUUM_GRENADE.DESCR
message.value: Greande can be activated by pressing SPACE! Creates a black hole, which draws surrounding units and objects. Units also get damage when colliding with ground under black hole's effect. Dissappears in 3 seconds, dealing additional damage.

message.name: VACUUM_GRENADE.DAMAGE
message.value: 30 hp in epicenter + collision damage.

message.name: VACUUM_GRENADE.HINT
message.value: Can be used to drown an enemy if activated in midair. Can deal huge damage in enclosed space.

message.name: BOOSTER.REWARD_X2.NAME
message.value: Double reward

message.name: BOOSTER.REWARD_X2.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Doubles experience and money earned in missions and boss battles.

message.name: BOOSTER.REWARD_X4.NAME
message.value: Quadruple reward

message.name: BOOSTER.REWARD_X4.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Increases experience and money in missions and boss battles by 4 times.

message.name: BOOSTER.REACTION_SMALL.NAME
message.value: Enhanced reaction

message.name: BOOSTER.REACTION_LARGE.NAME
message.value: Lightning reflexes

message.name: BOOSTER.REAGENTS.NAME
message.value: Secret sources

message.name: BOOSTER.REAGENTS.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Increases amount of reagents discovered in missions and boss battles by 30%.

message.name: DOCTOR_BAG.NAME
message.value: Doctor bag

message.name: DOCTOR_BAG.DESCR
message.value: Restores 75 hp to allies standing nearby and cures bleeding. Bag user's healing bonus improves the effect. Doesn't heal the user themself! Doesn't waste a turn.

dictionary.message: The bag is especially great if you manage to target several allies.

message.name: UNDERWATER_BREATH_POTION.NAME
message.value: Underwater breath

message.name: UNDERWATER_BREATH_POTION.DESCR
message.value: Allows to stay under the water for 4 turns. Only turns that ended with this unit are counted. Be careful: effect vanishes at the end of the turn. Doesn't waste a turn.

dictionary.message: Use before diving!

message.name: ALCHEMIST_FLASK.NAME
message.value: Alchemist flask

message.name: ALCHEMIST_FLASK.HINT
message.value: Make armored foe greatly vulnerable, increase ally's protection – this thing has many uses.

message.name: FIERY_PUMPKIN.NAME
message.value: Fiery pumpkin

message.name: FIERY_PUMPKIN.DESCR
message.value: The pumpkin is set on a ground and ignites large area in front of it. Burning embers finally explode, dealing additional damage depends on fire bonuses.

message.name: FIERY_PUMPKIN.DAMAGE
message.value: 35 hp from explosions, fire damage 30 hp per second

message.name: FIERY_PUMPKIN.HINT
message.value: Push together several enemies and just burn them away!

message.name: FOUL_WATERMELON.NAME
message.value: Foul watermelon

message.name: FOUL_WATERMELON.DESCR
message.value: Very stinky version of a common watermelon. It's ground destruction is a bit weaker, but it deals far poison damage and poisons units for 5 turns. Also this thing is rather fragile and explodes on second collision.

message.name: FOUL_WATERMELON.DAMAGE
message.value: 40 hp from exlosion, 6 stinky slices for 35 hp each

message.name: FOUL_WATERMELON.HINT
message.value: This watermelon deals enormous damage, still destroying plenty of landmass. Really great deal.

message.name: ZOMBIE_MARCH.NAME
message.value: Zombie march

message.name: ZOMBIE_MARCH.DESCR
message.value: Three graves drop into pointed location, revealing zombie troopers that join your team. These zombies have equally distributed attack and armor points. Graves also deal moderate damage on landing.

message.name: ZOMBIE_MARCH.DAMAGE
message.value: 3 graves for 40 hp each

message.name: ZOMBIE_MARCH.HINT
message.value: Reliable reinforcements that can save the game. Use the landscape, so your enemy couldn't destroy them in one turn.

message.name: SNOWFLAKE_STRIKE.NAME
message.value: Freezing shower

message.name: SNOWFLAKE_STRIKE.DESCR
message.value: Forms 7 snowflakes above pointed location, which fall on the ground. Snowflakes can be cast away by the wind! On collision with ground they deal damage and freeze units for 3 turns, while landscape stays untouched.

message.name: SNOWFLAKE_STRIKE.DAMAGE
message.value: 7 snowflakes for 45 hp each

message.name: SNOWFLAKE_STRIKE.HINT
message.value: Powerful air attack, we advise to train it a bit before going into real battle. Be careful, weapon is useless against enemies with cold protection!

message.name: REINFORCEMENT_CALL.NAME
message.value: Reinforcement call

message.name: REINFORCEMENT_CALL.DESCR
message.value: A fresh unit from your team will be dropped at a given point after the next player's turn. There must be no obstacles above drop point. If there are no spare units in your team, you'll get a random mercenary of your level. New unit appears with 50% of normal health.

dictionary.message: Calling for reinforcement will spend your turn and give your enemy chance to counter the threat. Make sure you'll survive a turn, and enemy won't destroy the ground beneath drop point.

message.name: NAIL_GRENADE.NAME
message.value: Nail grenade

message.name: NAIL_GRENADE.DESCR
message.value: Grenade is activated in 1.5 seconds after the throw, hanging in the midair and shooting nails at nearest units: both your allies and enemies!

message.name: NAIL_GRENADE.DAMAGE
message.value: 12 nails for 16 hp each

message.name: NAIL_GRENADE.HINT
message.value: Try to throw this grenade so it affects only one enemy, in this case he'll get major damage. Remember that your own units can also be hit with this grenade!

message.name: AIR_BLOCKER.NAME
message.value: Grounding bot

message.name: AIR_BLOCKER.DESCR
message.value: Device which can be attached to any surface to damage nearby enemies that stay in the air for too long. Stays for 10 turns, increasing its radius every turn. Releases electric orb on destruction, that deals damage, wastes a turn and can bounce to nearby enemies up to 2 times. Doesn't spend a turn.

message.name: AIR_BLOCKER.DAMAGE
message.value: 40 hp on trigger and on destruction

message.name: AIR_BLOCKER.HINT
message.value: Greatly disturbs enemy who relies on flying devices.

message.name: GLAZED_DONUT.NAME
message.value: Glazed donut

message.name: GLAZED_DONUT.DESCR
message.value: Changes the race of a unit it hits on random: Crab (problems with aiming), Snail (very slow), Donut (great chance to dodge). Dealing moderate damage. Effect lasts for 5 turns.

message.name: GLAZED_DONUT.DAMAGE
message.value: 70 hp

message.name: GLAZED_DONUT.HINT
message.value: It can prove very useful to get your opponent rid of their race abilities.

message.name: PUSHING_MINE.NAME
message.value: Stunt mine

message.name: PUSHING_MINE.DESCR
message.value: This mine can be put under the enemy and it tosses them up in 3 seconds, so you can attack them in midair. Doesn't deal damage and doesn't waste a turn.

dictionary.message: Really shines in combination with pushing weapons. Feel free to experiment!

message.name: EXPLOSION_DELAY.NOTE
message.value: Explodes after full stop. You may set the timer for 1 second by holding SHIFT while charging.

message.name: BOOSTER.REACTION_SMALL.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Rises your reaction level to 12, increasing the chances of going first in battles. If you already have level 12 or greater, it increases by 1.

message.name: BOOSTER.REACTION_LARGE.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Rises your reaction level to 18, greatly increasing the chances of going first in battles. If you already have level 18 or greater, it increases by 2.

message.name: RESURRECTION_SEAL.NAME
message.value: Resurrection seal

message.name: RESURRECTION_SEAL.DESCR
message.value: Use the seal on a grave to raise a zombie battleing on your side. Doesn't waste a turn.

dictionary.message: Keep your eye for the headstones, they're not useless granite slabs anymore!

message.name: RADIO_MAST.NAME
message.value: Radio mast

message.name: RADIO_MAST.DESCR
message.value: Radiomast must be set in open space and starts working on your next turn. In active state it increases the damage of your air attacks by 40%. Radiomast has 100 hp and can be destroyed with regular attacks. If there are several of your radiomasts on the map, only one is active per time. Doesn't waste a turn.

dictionary.message: The mast can be set only in open space. Remember that your enemy may destroy the mast with their attacks or block it with girder.

message.name: ANTIDOTE.DESCR
message.value: Removes poisoning from your ally. Doesn't waste a turn.

dictionary.message: Returns your poisoned teammate back to action! Your units can't use it on themselves!

message.name: ADRENALINE.DESCR
message.value: Removes from the ally the effects of freezing, slowing down, and protecting them for 12 turns. Doesn't waste a turn.

dictionary.message: Removes from the ally negative effects limiting movement, as well as protects them for 12 turns. Your units can't use it on themselves!

message.name: ARCTIC_TORCH.NAME
message.value: Arctic torch

message.name: ARCTIC_TORCH.DESCR
message.value: Torch with extremely hot fire, capable of melting even the most thick ice.

message.name: BUNDLE.SAVE
message.value: You save

message.name: BUNDLE.CONTENT
message.value: In this bundle:

message.name: BUNDLE.CARROT.NAME
message.value: Starter's bundle

message.name: BUNDLE.CARROT.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Great weapon pack that immediately puts you into aciton!

message.name: BUNDLE.FIRE.NAME
message.value: Pyromancer's bundle

message.name: BUNDLE.FIRE.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Really hot bundle to set your enemies on fire!

message.name: BUNDLE.AIR.NAME
message.value: Bombardier's bundle

message.name: BUNDLE.AIR.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Breathtaking pack that brings destruction from above!

message.name: BUNDLE.ARMS.NAME
message.value: Dangerous bundle

message.name: BUNDLE.ARMS.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Bundle with heavy explosives to blast both your enemies and landscape!

message.name: SNIPER_RIFLE.NAME
message.value: Sniper rifle

message.name: SNIPER_RIFLE.DESCR
message.value: Decent rifle, allowing you to make one precise shot, carefully aiming with the laser beam. It is capable to pierce several units with one shot, but each subsequent target gets lower damage. Damage increses with distance travelled.

message.name: SNIPER_RIFLE.NOTE
message.value: The nearby targets get decreased damage.

message.name: SNIPER_RIFLE.DAMAGE
message.value: up to 90 hp for the first target

message.name: FAKE_ATOMIC_BOMB.NAME
message.value: Fake atomic bomb

message.name: FAKE_ATOMIC_BOMB.DESCR
message.value: Places a special mark on the map without spending a turn. On your next turn a FAKE bomb will be dropped at this mark. Fake bomb behaves just like regular one, but causes much less destruction.

message.name: FAKE_ATOMIC_BOMB.DAMAGE
message.value: 60 hp

message.name: FAKE_ATOMIC_BOMB.HINT
message.value: Use the fake bomb to distract an enemy and make them spend resources to cover from atomic strike. Also feel free to use it for plain air damage.

dictionary.message:
Attention!
Different reaction boosters don't sum! Only the bigger bonus works.

message.name: ANVIL.DESCR
message.value: A heavy anvil drops at target point, pushing a victim into ground and destroying lying objects. The anvil also stays on a ground, preventing enemy from getting out.

message.name: ANVIL.DAMAGE
message.value: 70 hp

message.name: ANVIL.HINT
message.value: Great weapon to trap an enemy, if they don't have turn switch or emergency teleport. Anvil's ability to break ground while falling can be used to push enemies down to water.

message.name: TELEPORT_ANCHOR.NAME
message.value: Anchor teleporter

message.name: TELEPORT_ANCHOR.DESCR
message.value: Places a special mark on your unit's position. The unit then is teleported on this mark at the end of a turn. The mark lasts for 8 seconds. Doesn't waste a turn!

dictionary.message: It can be very useful to teleport back to safety after performing your turn.

message.name: GIRDER_GUN.NAME
message.value: Girder bazooka

message.name: GIRDER_GUN.DESCR
message.value: Shoots a small girder, which gets stuck in the ground and stays on the map. Units hit by girder are pushed aside without taking any damage, though deals 30 hp of damage to stationary objects. Doesn't waste a turn!

message.name: GIRDER_GUN.DAMAGE
message.value: 30 hp

message.name: GIRDER_GUN.HINT
message.value: Lots of useful interactions! You may displace or block your enemy or cover your ally without wasting a turn.

message.name: FROST_STASIS.NAME
message.value: Frost stasis

message.name: FROST_STASIS.DESCR
message.value: All your troops are placed into ice blocks that protect from any damage (but not from drowning) and greatly reduce knockback. Units inside blocks heal 10 hp every turn, overwriting healing from antitoxin. Ice block shatters when a unit gets a turn. Doesn't work on revived zombies!

dictionary.message: The barrier can help you to escape from hard situation, for example when your main attacker is about to get killed, or your team is poisoned, or you are targeted by atomic bomb. Make sure there's enough landmass under your troops!

message.name: ELECTROMAGNETIC_BAZOOKA.NAME
message.value: Electromagnetic missile

message.name: ELECTROMAGNETIC_BAZOOKA.DESCR
message.value: On explosion this missile blocks 3 random weapons for 3 turns in the arsenal of all victims. Also deals shock damage. Missile is affected by the wind!

dictionary.message: Gives huge advantage if used at right moment, interfering your enemy's strategy.

message.name: ELECTROMAGNETIC_BAZOOKA.DAMAGE
message.value: 70 hp

message.name: COOLDOWN_RESET_DEVICE.NAME
message.value: Cooldown nullifier

message.name: COOLDOWN_RESET_DEVICE.DESCR
message.value: When used, removes cooldown from one random weapon and equips it. Doesn't waste a turn!

message.name: INTERFERENCE_GENERATOR.NAME
message.value: Jamming device

message.name: INTERFERENCE_GENERATOR.DESCR
message.value: The device is set on the ground and prevents ALL players from using airstrikes and all means of teleportation. Device has 100 hp and can be destroyed by regular attacks. Doesn't waste a turn!

message.name: GRENADE_BUNCH.NAME
message.value: Grenade bunch

message.name: GRENADE_BUNCH.DESCR
message.value: The soldier throws 4 grenades which are picked randomly from your backpack. All grenades are spent as on normal usage.

message.name: RANDOM_ROCKET_BAZOOKA.NAME
message.value: Double-barreled bazooka

message.name: RANDOM_ROCKET_BAZOOKA.DESCR
message.value: Launches 2 random missile weapons from your backpack with slight delay. Missiles used this way become blocked for 2 turns.

message.name: BAG_HACK_DEVICE.DESCR
message.value: With this device you can block one of known weapons in enemy's arsenal for 2 turns. Must be used while standing near enemy unit. Doesn't spend a turn.

message.name: MOLE.DESCR
message.value: Launches the mole that digs the ground at given direction for 3 seconds. Mole explodes if it stumble upon an enemy, water, or empty space. The damage is increasing while mole is moving.

message.name: MOLE.DAMAGE
message.value: from 10 hp to 200 hp, depending on distance travelled

message.name: MORTAR_TURRET.NAME
message.value: Stationary mortar

message.name: MORTAR_TURRET.DESCR
message.value: The mortar is placed on a flat ground without wasting a turn. Requires an unblocked mortar in the arsenal. At the end of each turn shoots at random enemy within its range, using your mortar's ammo. Activates after the next enemy's turn. Doesn't get a bonus from owner's attack. Performs up to 4 shots. The turret has 100 hp and can be destroyed by regular attacks. Doesn't waste a turn!

message.name: FIREARM_TURRET.NAME
message.value: Firearm centry turret

message.name: FIREARM_TURRET.DESCR
message.value: The turret is placed on a flat ground without wasting a turn. Requires an unblocked Minigun, AK-47, Uzi, Rifle or Sniper rifle in the arsenal, or any of their upgrades. Before placing it you can choose weapon that the turret fill fire more common, if there are viable targets within range (otherwise it will choose another weapon). At the end of each turn shoots using selected weapon's ammo. Activates after the next enemy's turn Doesn't get a bonus from owner's attack. Performs up to 4 shots. The turret has 100 hp and can be destroyed by regular attacks. Doesn't waste a turn!

message.name: MESSY_BOMBARDMENT.NAME
message.value: Chaotic bombardment

message.name: MESSY_BOMBARDMENT.DESCR
message.value: Bombards the target point with random air missiles from your arsenal, wasting their ammo. Up to 8 missiles can be launched this way.

dictionary.message: This device may save your life by removing cooldown from weapon, vital to finish your enemy.
Generator may secure your victory forbidding your enemy from escaping and healing or from finishing you with air strike.

Though you can't predict which grenades would be thrown, this weapon is capable of dealing tremendous damage. Especially when the enemy is staying in enclosed space, so the grenades won't spread away.
Two missiles – double effect. You can make the weapon more predictable by leaving only necessary missiles in backpack.
You can make the battle far more difficult for your enemy by blocking their rope or turn switch.

Great weapon against enemies who hide underground. It's better to launch mole at slight angle, to make it more difficult for enemy to escape out of the tunnel. Sometimes can be used to throw enemies into the water!
Additional damage at the end of turn is always handy, in the worst case the mortar will take some damage from enemy attacks. Mortar is especially useful against bosses.
Additional damage at the end of turn is always handy, in the worst case the turret will take some damage from enemy attacks. Turret is especially useful against bosses.
Huge amount of damage at the target point for the price of your air arsenal.

message.name: PLASMAGUN.DESCR
message.value: Emits a plasma ball, burning everything on its way. Ball passes through ground, leaving a smoldering trail. Explodes on collision with units, igniting the nearby ground, and reducing their fire protection by 20% until end of turn. Ball has slight home towards closest enemy in a small radius,

message.name: PLASMAGUN.DAMAGE
message.value: 40 hp out of explosion, fire damage 30 hp per second

message.name: PLASMAGUN.HINT
message.value: Like all other fire-based weapon, it's the most effective, when enemy is standing in enclosed space. Use it against enemies who are hiding underground, you may also try to straddle several enemies with the fire trail.

message.name: POISONOUS_HEAL_FLASK.NAME
message.value: Murky tincture

message.name: POISONOUS_HEAL_FLASK.DESCR
message.value: When thrown at any unit, reduces poison protection by 100% (protection can't become lower than 0). The effect lasts for 6 turns. Clears the effect of Antitoxin. Doesn't spend a turn.

dictionary.message: This potion allows you to poison even the enemies with high resistance!

message.name: BUNDLE.ANIMAL.NAME
message.value: Animal bundle

message.name: BUNDLE.ANIMAL.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Who said that animals are inferior to machines?

message.name: BUNDLE.NAVAL.NAME
message.value: Naval bundle

message.name: BUNDLE.NAVAL.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Show that landlubbers who is the real sea dog here!

message.name: BUNDLE.SECRET.NAME
message.value: Secret bundle

message.name: BUNDLE.SECRET.DESCRIPTION
message.value: This bundle is here by mistake, don't even try to buy it!

message.name: BUNDLE.TOXIC.NAME
message.value: Toxic bundle

message.name: BUNDLE.TOXIC.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Dangerous poisons gathered from the most exotic places on the planet!

message.name: BUNDLE.BURNING.NAME
message.value: Flammable bundle

message.name: BUNDLE.BURNING.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Don't play with matches... take something more serious!

message.name: BOOSTER.WEEK_VIP.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Allows you to change race, rename characters, reset parameters and awards for achievements for free.{br}Doubles experience and money earned in missions and boss battles.{br}Grants additional reagent in missions and boss battles.{br}Rises your reaction level to 18. If your reaction level is already 18 or greater, it's increased by 2.{br}Reduces the time to restore combat tokens by half.

message.name: BOOSTER.MONTH_VIP.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Allows you to change race, rename characters, reset parameters and awards for achievements for free.{br}Doubles experience and money earned in missions and boss battles.{br}Grants additional reagent in missions and boss battles.{br}Rises your reaction level to 18. If your reaction level is already 18 or greater, it's increased by 2.{br}Reduces the time to restore combat tokens by half.

message.name: CHROMEORB.NAME
message.value: Frozen orb

message.name: CHROMEORB.DESCR
message.value: Magic sphere of uncertain origin. Shoots multiple ice shards that aim towards enemies. Units hit by the orb are frozen for 2 turns. Enemies hit by at least 2 shards are slowed for 2 turns. Orb and shards are affected by wind!

message.name: CHROMEORB.DAMAGE
message.value: 50 hp orb damage, 30 hp shard damage

message.name: CHROMEORB.HINT
message.value: Your units are protected from slowing caused by ice shards. Try to slow as much enemies as you can by throwing the orb with the maximum power.

dictionary.message: Dark elixir grants +10 armor and saves from drowning once, teleporting character to random location instead.
Whene enemy sets a heal blocker, you can't restore health. But it will disappear in several turns!
When a character is in stasis, they can't be damaged. But it's still possible to sink them in water!
When character's repell chance is triggered, missiles may bounce away from them and fly to random direction!
Character has a chance to dodge attacks. Weapons that attack with lots of bullets are ineffective against them.
The character had a water protection. But now you can finally sink them, and they won't be saved this time!

message.name: BUNDLE.COLD.NAME
message.value: Chilling bundle

message.name: BUNDLE.COLD.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Chill down the hottest enemies with your ice cold game!

message.name: BUNDLE.JUDGMENT.NAME
message.value: Judgement bundle

message.name: BUNDLE.JUDGMENT.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Cast a real apocalypse for your foes!

message.name: BUNDLE.CRIMINAL.NAME
message.value: Criminal bundle

message.name: BUNDLE.CRIMINAL.DESCRIPTION
message.value: The best weapons of local bandits – this will definitely help you!

message.name: BUNDLE.MINER.NAME
message.value: Miner's bundle

message.name: BUNDLE.MINER.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Are you ready to bury your enemies under tons of earth?

message.name: BUNDLE.RARITY.NAME
message.value: Relics bundle

message.name: BUNDLE.RARITY.DESCRIPTION
message.value: This dusty crate was found in cellars of forsaken castle... Who'll get the ancient treasures now?

message.name: BUNDLE.FORBIDDEN.NAME
message.value: Forbidden bundle

message.name: BUNDLE.FORBIDDEN.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Revolutionary weapons, altering the physical properties of matter...

message.name: BUNDLE.FESTIVE.NAME
message.value: Festive bundle

message.name: BUNDLE.FESTIVE.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Make a holiday any time you wish – how's your enemy is going to counter that?

message.name: BUNDLE.PERSIAN.NAME
message.value: Persian bundle

message.name: BUNDLE.PERSIAN.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Nobody knows the history of this crate but we can tell for sure: its contents are deadly!

message.name: BUNDLE.POLICE.NAME
message.value: Police bundle

message.name: BUNDLE.POLICE.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Are you brave enough to rein in any villain? This bundle is for you!

message.name: BUNDLE.ENGINEERING.NAME
message.value: Engineering bundle

message.name: BUNDLE.ENGINEERING.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Quickly buy this bundle, while its owners frogot about it!

message.name: BUNDLE.STORM.NAME
message.value: Storm bundle

message.name: BUNDLE.STORM.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Cover any battlefield with a storm cloud from this crate!

message.name: BUNDLE.GROUND.NAME
message.value: Earthly bundle

message.name: BUNDLE.GROUND.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Born to crawl can't fly, but it's possible to punish those who try to escape!

message.name: BUNDLE.SPYWARE.NAME
message.value: Spy bundle

message.name: BUNDLE.SPYWARE.DESCRIPTION
message.value: A crate filled with spy gadgets – are you ready to amuse enemies with such toolkit?

message.name: BUNDLE.SAVING.NAME
message.value: Lifeguard bundle

message.name: BUNDLE.SAVING.DESCRIPTION
message.value: You can't find more joy in this gray world? The bundle for most confusing scenarios is what you need!

message.name: BUNDLE.HEAVENLY.NAME
message.value: Heavenly budnle

message.name: BUNDLE.HEAVENLY.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Fly like a dragon, crush like a rhino!

message.name: PUPPET.NAME
message.value: Pesky Doll

message.name: PUPPET.DESCR
message.value: Doll is thrown as grenade and attaches to enemy it hits. Doll captures most types of healing (doesn't work on healing from most bosses' unique abilities), increasing own health by that many. Captures only half of Rabbits' healing via their carrots. To remove the Doll, victim has to take damage from themself or their allies, decreasing Doll's health. By default, the Doll has 150 hp. If thrown into bosses, the Doll automatically vanishes upon 10 turns, dealing slight damage.

message.name: PUPPET.DAMAGE
message.value: 10 hp on hit, 10 hp on destruction

message.name: PUPPET.HINT
message.value: The doll doesn't deal much damage. Its role is in preventing enemy's healing and forcing them to deal damage to themselves. Just use it on enemies with high regeneration!

message.name: LULLABY_ELIXIR.NAME
message.value: Hypnotic elixir

message.name: LULLABY_ELIXIR.DESCR
message.value: Enemy unit hit by elixir is put to sleep during your turns, removing dodge and repell effects from them. The effect lasts for 4 turns. Doesn't waste a turn. Doesn't affect dodge by Cat's and Donut's racial abilities.

dictionary.message: A reliable way to make vulnerably your most dodgy enemies!

message.name: HUNGRY_GARY.NAME
message.value: Hungry Harry

message.name: HUNGRY_GARY.DESCR
message.value: Huge carnivorous flower. Attacks moving enemy in area of effect, dealing severe damage and pushing them aside. Disappears after 3 attacks. Only one Harry at time is allowed! Can't be placed if there's only 1 enemy left! After using Harry, the fighter cannot step aside! Harry has 200 hp and can be killed with regular attacks. Blind to units if there's ground between their eyes and them, even if they are inside detection radius.

message.name: HUNGRY_GARY.DAMAGE
message.value: 90 hp per attack

message.name: HUNGRY_GARY.HINT
message.value: Harry is an excellent defender of your tactical interests on the map!

message.name: SWAP_TELEPORT.NAME
message.value: Reverse teleport

message.name: SWAP_TELEPORT.DESCR
message.value: Exchanges your unit with any other in the radius of effect. All your devices at point of teleportation are destroyed by explosion. After using both units receive knockback reduction for 1 turn. Each unit can participate in reverse teleport only once per battle! Can't be used close to water.

message.name: SWAP_TELEPORT.NOTE
message.value: Use left/right arrows to choose units, press SPACE to select.

message.name: SWAP_TELEPORT.HINT
message.value: Turn timer is still ticking while you select a unit, so try to use it faster. Use left/right arrows or A/D to choose units, press SPACE to select.

message.name: ROBO_PIRANHA.DESCR
message.value: Releases aggressive robopiranhas to the water. At the end of a turn they attack nearest unit that stands close to water, both enemies and allies. Disappear after attack. Doesn't affect most bosses and units with a vile pumpkin and a gift box.

message.name: ROBO_PIRANHA.DAMAGE
message.value: 5 piranhas for 30 hp each

message.name: ROBO_PIRANHA.HINT
message.value: Robopiranhas stay in water till the end of battle, but attack only once.

message.name: ROBO_PIRANHA.NOTE
message.value: Better keep far from water, when piranhas are active, it's very easy to waste a turn on them!

message.name: BUNDLE.RURAL.NAME
message.value: Rural bundle

message.name: BUNDLE.RURAL.DESCRIPTION
message.value: This bundle contains a secret of strange Farmer's apples!

message.name: BUNDLE.MUSIC.NAME
message.value: Music bundle

message.name: BUNDLE.MUSIC.DESCRIPTION
message.value: This bundle makes music sound differently!

message.name: BUNDLE.HAIRDRESSING.NAME
message.value: Barber bundle

message.name: BUNDLE.HAIRDRESSING.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Fascinating bundle of nice haircuts and an axe to take care as a bonus.

message.name: BUNDLE.LOST.NAME
message.value: Lost bundle

message.name: BUNDLE.LOST.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Box of wonders with curios arrived to us from the heart of Antlantis!

message.name: BUNDLE.NIGHT.NAME
message.value: Night bundle

message.name: BUNDLE.NIGHT.DESCRIPTION
message.value: With this bundle you feel safe walking in the dark of a night, looking for adventures.

message.name: BUNDLE.TIBETAN.NAME
message.value: Tibetan bundle

message.name: BUNDLE.TIBETAN.DESCRIPTION
message.value: With this bundle you may conceive the true mastery of Tibetan monks!

message.name: BUNDLE.MEXICAN.NAME
message.value: Mexican bundle

message.name: BUNDLE.MEXICAN.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Grab this hot bundle faster, until it burns the land down to Mexico!

message.name: BUNDLE.SPACE.NAME
message.value: Cosmic bundle

message.name: BUNDLE.SPACE.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Somewhat useful set, if you suddenly decide to travel to dee space for vacation!

message.name: BUNDLE.BLACK.NAME
message.value: Black bundle

message.name: BUNDLE.BLACK.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Elite gear of legendary cats in black – that's what you really need right now!

message.name: BUNDLE.THIEVES.NAME
message.value: Bundle of thieves

message.name: BUNDLE.THIEVES.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Great master Boaryaki-kun hooked us up with this bundle for unspeakable price.

message.name: BUNDLE.SWAMP.NAME
message.value: Swampy bundle

message.name: BUNDLE.SWAMP.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Eerie creature attacked local tourists ever and again, until one of them happened to carry a jackhammer.

message.name: BUNDLE.SIBERIAN.NAME
message.value: Siberian bundle

message.name: BUNDLE.SIBERIAN.DESCRIPTION
message.value: This frozen land contains thousands of riddles, the main of them how this crate got there?

message.name: BUNDLE.SHAMANIC.NAME
message.value: Shamanic bundle

message.name: BUNDLE.SHAMANIC.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Do you want to become a master of elements? Than this bundle is for you!

message.name: BUNDLE.SMALL_HEALERS.NAME
message.value: Small healer's bundle

message.name: BUNDLE.SMALL_HEALERS.DESCRIPTION
message.value: War is war! No holds barred! This small bundle will help you to win!

message.name: BUNDLE.MIDDLE_HEALERS.NAME
message.value: Medium healer's bundle

message.name: BUNDLE.MIDDLE_HEALERS.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Medium healer's bundle is irreplaceable in combat! No Wormix master of martial arts can do without it!

message.name: BUNDLE.LARGE_HEALERS.NAME
message.value: Large healer's bundle

message.name: BUNDLE.LARGE_HEALERS.DESCRIPTION
message.value: What can be better than this huge bundle? This pile of supplies saved brave Wormix fighters numerous times!

message.name: BUNDLE.PROFI-S.NAME
message.value: Case PROF-S

message.name: BUNDLE.PROFI-S.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Every war dog needs a box of professional tools to assist them in combat!

message.name: BUNDLE.PROFI-M.NAME
message.value: Case PROF-M

message.name: BUNDLE.PROFI-M.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Medium bundle of professional equipment will help in difficult battles!

message.name: BUNDLE.PROFI-L.NAME
message.value: Case PROF-L

message.name: BUNDLE.PROFI-L.DESCRIPTION
message.value: This is war! A huge case of a professional fighter will lead you to victory!

message.name: BUNDLE.SEASONAL.NAME
message.value: Seasonal bundle

message.name: BUNDLE.SEASONAL.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Contents of this box defies logic: it changes by itself over the time. You can buy wonders for money nonetheless!

message.name: BUNDLE.FAIRY_TALE.NAME
message.value: Fairy-tale bundle

message.name: BUNDLE.FAIRY_TALE.DESCRIPTION
message.value: A villain from this tale didn't have money for a dragon, so he put an asian mask on first available servant. There was no princess as well, and the knight just passed by... Humble, thrifty, a bit ridiculous – but everything fits this box!

message.name: BUNDLE.GREAT.NAME
message.value: Great bundle

message.name: BUNDLE.GREAT.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Why the helm is great? Because noone could loose it in such despicable way, that accident is now history – get it faster before others find it on a shelf!

message.name: BUNDLE.STRATEGIC.NAME
message.value: Strategic bundle

message.name: BUNDLE.STRATEGIC.DESCRIPTION
message.value: These items belonged to someone from ancient civilization. Huge ice cube, hat with ancient symbols, arctic sword – it's everything that left.

message.name: BUNDLE.HOMEMADE.NAME
message.value: Homemade bundle

message.name: BUNDLE.HOMEMADE.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Our workers decided to decorate a common hat with toxins, antidotes, potions... Mixing all the trash together they've got THIS. Want to get some?

message.name: BUNDLE.DEMONIC.NAME
message.value: Demonic bundle

message.name: BUNDLE.DEMONIC.DESCRIPTION
message.value: A package from underworld with a strange shield inside. Rumor has it, that the Lord of Hell watches everything above through the eye on this artifact.

message.name: BUNDLE.MYSTICAL.NAME
message.value: Mystical bundle

message.name: BUNDLE.MYSTICAL.DESCRIPTION
message.value: All who stay near this crate hear groans. Lingering and desperate as if there's not a strange stick with spikes inside, but hundreds of suffering souls.

message.name: BUNDLE.WILD.NAME
message.value: Wild bundle

message.name: BUNDLE.WILD.DESCRIPTION
message.value: One day we've caught a savage, who was stealing antitoxins – like he spent all of their life outside of civilization. And he couldn't just get away with this...

message.name: BUNDLE.GHOST.NAME
message.value: Ghostly bundle

message.name: BUNDLE.GHOST.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Strange things happen in this place: thunder is sounding and lightnings are flashing. There's a rumor that if you manage to dispel this sorcery, you'll get a magical hat!

message.name: BUNDLE.GOLD.NAME
message.value: Golden bundle

message.name: BUNDLE.GOLD.DESCRIPTION
message.value: What happens if you ram a jetpack with flying saucer in the middle of a desert, then pour top-quality napalm on this, and finally toss a ruby? If we mention that this thing is scandinavian, it's a good item to scare the pants off your enemies!

message.name: BUNDLE.DIPLOMATIC.NAME
message.value: Diplomatic bundle

message.name: BUNDLE.DIPLOMATIC.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Our diplomats could explain to the Emperor, that they don't need their treasure, and they will remain friends if he grants them one of their hats. Now that ruler has a barrel of toxins, and you have an opportunity to buy a rare item!

message.name: BUNDLE.EAGLE.NAME
message.value: Eagle bundle

message.name: BUNDLE.EAGLE.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Druids that live in local forests tame animals and speak with the trees. If you catch one of them, you may scrounge a good item.

message.name: BUNDLE.UNSUCCESSFUL.NAME
message.value: Unlucky bundle

message.name: BUNDLE.UNSUCCESSFUL.DESCRIPTION
message.value: One affluent researcher leaked a hint that Sword of depths was developed by Engineer, improved version of Vampiric sword. Nobody could discover an upgrade technology, but lots of useful knowledge remained from experiments...

message.name: BUNDLE.SECRETIVE.NAME
message.value: Hermit bundle

message.name: BUNDLE.SECRETIVE.DESCRIPTION
message.value: A solitary hermit, a master of martial arts, roamed the snowy peaks and found a bandage of a fallen robot. Just think what effect this had... The old veteran carried this secret to the grave, but it could not be hidden.

message.name: BUNDLE.CURSED_NEON.NAME
message.value: Jade bundle

message.name: BUNDLE.CURSED_NEON.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Cursed jade is the most mysterious thing in the game. Manipulations with ice, toxic substances and gravity in a complete vacuum... There's a few experimental tanks left – take it, before someone else gets it and brings it on you!

message.name: PROMPT.WATER_PROTECTION_FIRST_ACT
message.value: This unit has water protection until their firsr turn in the equipment. They cannot be drowned until they finally make their turn!

dictionary.message: When an enemy grounding device is installed, you can not fly freely in its area of operation. But it will disappear after a few moves!

message.name: SOUL_GUN_FREEZE.NAME
message.value: Freezing soulgun

message.name: SOUL_GUN_FREEZE.DISTINCT
message.value: Depends on frost bonuses. First target hit by at least 3 souls will get additional damage and become frozen.

message.name: SOUL_GUN_FREEZE.DESCR
message.value: Launch many frozen souls in the region of sight. Souls choose an occasional goal, not breaking their own and others', and on the way to it they can go through the earth. The less the life of the shooter, the greater the damage to each soul. If the soul does not find a goal, it pounces on the shooter themself! The first goal, which will hit 3 souls, will receive additional damage from the cold and will be frozen.

message.name: THEIF_ATTACK_WEAPON.DESCR
message.value: In direct hit with the fighter reduces their points of attack to 30 (no more than 35 points against AI units) for 17 turns, spends turn. In contact with the ground in a small radius reduces the points of attack to 40 (no more than 25 points agains AI units) for 11 turns, turn doesn't spend.

message.name: THEIF_ATTACK_WEAPON.DAMAGE
message.value: 10 hp in direct hit

message.name: THEIF_ATTACK_WEAPON.HINT
message.value: Especially effective against groups of enemies with high attack.

message.name: BOSS_FIRE_MINIGUN.DESCR
message.value: Releases fire souls in the direction of the sight. Souls are homing at the enemies through the ground!

message.name: BOSS_FIRE_MINIGUN.DAMAGE
message.value: 12 fire souls for 12 hp each

message.name: BOSS_FIRE_MINIGUN.HINT
message.value: Just aim at the enemy and fire!

message.name: SUPER_DRILL_MISSILE.NAME
message.value: Superdrill rocket

message.name: SUPER_DRILL_MISSILE.DESCR
message.value: A missile, which can get a unit hiding under the ground or behind an obstacle! Has larger drilling radius compared to regular drill rocket. It is influenced by the wind.

message.name: SUPER_DRILL_MISSILE.DAMAGE
message.value: 80 hp

message.name: BUNDLE.SMALL_HEALERS_FULL.NAME
message.value: Healer's bundle FULL-X

message.name: BUNDLE.SMALL_HEALERS_FULL.DESCRIPTION
message.value: A complete set of items that are so much needed by any soldier, packed in one small bundle!
