message.name: BUNDLE.MIDDLE_HEALERS_FULL.NAME
message.value: Healer's bundle FULL-Y

message.name: BUNDLE.MIDDLE_HEALERS_FULL.DESCRIPTION
message.value: A complete set of items that are so much needed by any soldier, packed in one medium set!

message.name: BUNDLE.LARGE_HEALERS_FULL.NAME
message.value: Healer's bundle FULL-Z

message.name: BUNDLE.LARGE_HEALERS_FULL.DESCRIPTION
message.value: A complete set of items that are so much needed by any soldier, packed in one large set!

message.name: THUNDER_HAMMER.NAME
message.value: Thunder hammer

message.name: THUNDER_HAMMER.DESCR
message.value: Enemies hit by the hammer are thrown away with a very high speed. When the victim collides with ground or another unit, it will cause a powerful electric explosion that destroys ground and slows the victim. Main hit deals physical damage.

message.name: THUNDER_HAMMER.DAMAGE
message.value: 60 hp hit damage, 100 hp explosion damage

message.name: THUNDER_HAMMER.HINT
message.value: Thunder hammer the best tool for sending enemy towards the ancestors. Angle-up/down arrows. Stand near enemy and press SPACE to attack.

message.name: RED_HOT_HAMMER.NAME
message.value: Red hot hammer

message.name: RED_HOT_HAMMER.DESCR
message.value: The powerful strike buries the enemy in the ground, where he will be fried to a crisp. Hammer damage cannot be critical and ignores attack and armor damage modifiers. Instantly destroys most stationary objects.

message.name: RED_HOT_HAMMER.DAMAGE
message.value: 160 hp hit damage, fire damage 30 hp per second fire damage

message.name: RED_HOT_HAMMER.HINT
message.value: Red hot hammer buries the enemy deep in the ground and additionally causes serious fire damage. Stand near enemy and press SPACE to attack.

message.name: BUNDLE.BUNDLE_RACE.NAME
message.value: Race bundle

message.name: BUNDLE.BUNDLE_RACE.DESCRIPTION
message.value: The best copies straight from the laboratory of the Project-X are collected in this set, and at an attractive price!

message.name: BUNDLE.SEASONAL_KILLER.NAME
message.value: Killer set

message.name: BUNDLE.SEASONAL_KILLER.DESCRIPTION
message.value: This set with seasonal weapons is the most important for epic battles!

message.name: BUNDLE.SEASONAL_MASTER.NAME
message.value: Master set

message.name: BUNDLE.SEASONAL_MASTER.DESCRIPTION
message.value: A holiday set with seasonal weapon for effective combat!

message.name: ENERGY_RIFLE.NAME
message.value: Energy rifle

message.name: ENERGY_RIFLE.DESCR
message.value: Shoots an energy bullet, which damages and pushes unit into the air. Has an improved crosshair.

message.name: ENERGY_RIFLE.DAMAGE
message.value: 75 hp

message.name: HANDICRAFTED_RIFLE.NAME
message.value: Handicrafted rifle

message.name: HANDICRAFTED_RIFLE.DESCR
message.value: Intresting and useful weapon. Shoots Ground Breaker shards. Emits a powerful explosion when it hits an enemy. If the missile hits the ground and you have Thunderstrike or Thunderbird shots, this shot will be consumed and all objects in an area of explosition will be destroyed.

message.name: HANDICRAFTED_RIFLE.DAMAGE
message.value: 140 hp at direct hit

message.name: HANDICRAFTED_RIFLE.HINT
message.value: With this weapon, it's very convenient to push enemies of the ground edge and destroy their defence. Use up/down keys to change angle. Press and hold space to adjust power.

message.name: GAS_GRENADE_SHOCK.NAME
message.value: Shock therapy

message.name: GAS_GRENADE_SHOCK.DESCR
message.value: Creates an electrostatic field, that deals shock damage to all units for 4 turns, and also damages units that try to move through the field. It doesn't disrupts turn of most bosses.

message.name: GAS_GRENADE_SHOCK.DAMAGE
message.value: 50 hp each turn, extra 50 hp when detects movement

message.name: GAS_GRENADE_SHOCK.HINT
message.value: Can force the enemy to leave a good position. Perfectly works as a trap for turn disruptions! Remember that the cloud also deals damage to allied units!

message.name: REVERSE_GRAVITY_BAZOOKA.NAME
message.value: Reverse gravitybazooka

message.name: REVERSE_GRAVITY_BAZOOKA.DESCR
message.value: Shoots a powerful rocket that distorts the laws of physics! In direct hit with units pushes them against own velocity direction, and in hit with the ground deals up to triple damage to all units nearby. Can be used to push units towards the crosshair when used in close proximity, not dealing any damage to attacker. Still affected by the wind.

message.name: REVERSE_GRAVITY_BAZOOKA.DAMAGE
message.value: 60 hp

message.name: ELECTROMAGNETIC_GUN.DESCR
message.value: Incredible weapon that can destroy stationary objects (such as blockers and force field) and deal damage from long distances. Missile travels through the ground and isn't affected by the wind.

message.name: ELECTROMAGNETIC_GUN.DAMAGE
message.value: 100 hp

message.name: METEOR_VOLLEY.NAME
message.value: Meteor valley attack

message.name: METEOR_VOLLEY.DESCR
message.value: Unleashes a volley of homing meteorites vertically, slightly angled, that can also dig through the ground.

message.name: METEOR_VOLLEY.DAMAGE
message.value: 5 meteorites for 50 hp each

message.name: TRANSLOCATOR.DESCR
message.value: Chooses an enemy unit and teleports your ally to them (closest to the target unit ally is chosen). Targets who make their first turn earlier are chosen prioritely. The attacking fighter themselves can only be teleported if they have no allies.

message.name: TRANSLOCATOR.DAMAGE
message.value: 40 hp

message.name: CHAIN_GUN.NAME
message.value: Wandering lightning

message.name: CHAIN_GUN.DESCR
message.value: Shoots an electric missile, that bounces to nearby enemy units a few times. Most effective against group of units. Missile travels through the ground!

message.name: CHAIN_GUN.DAMAGE
message.value: 60 hp

message.name: ASSASSIN_KNIFE.DESCR
message.value: Dangerous knife can pierce through the ground and deal high damage, also poisons the target for 10 turns, ignoring poison power and defense parameters, and has increased maximum poison damage (up to 200 hp). Highly affected by the wind.

message.name: ASSASSIN_KNIFE.DAMAGE
message.value: 90 hp, poison damage is capped at 200 hp

message.name: FAN_OF_KNIVES.NAME
message.value: Assassin's dance

message.name: FAN_OF_KNIVES.DESCR
message.value: Unleashes a barrage of deadly blades, distributing them among all enemies on the map and poisoning units for 10 turns on direct hit. Blade's poison ignores poison power and defense parameters and has increases maximum poison damage (up to 200 hp). First direct hit to every unit deals double damage.

message.name: FAN_OF_KNIVES.DAMAGE
message.value: 34 knifes for 25 hp each, poison damage is capped at 200 hp

message.name: BUNDLE.HOLOGRAM_KIT.NAME
message.value: Hologram set

message.name: BUNDLE.HOLOGRAM_KIT.DESCRIPTION
message.value: The source of the Archbot's magic – the mysterious ring of their staff, which is in this box. Do you want to learn the technomagic?

message.name: BUNDLE.MAGMATIC_KIT.NAME
message.value: Magma set

message.name: BUNDLE.MAGMATIC_KIT.DESCRIPTION
message.value: The main value of the solar crown and the blacksmith's helmet is in the drops of magma that are used in their composition. Don't burn the chair and just buy a flask of this substance!

message.name: ALCHEMIST_FLASK.DESCR
message.value: After hitting a unit, changes their baseline attack and defense by shifting half the larger parameter to the smaller one. Can be thrown at allies. Has no effect on most bosses. Lasts for 2 turns after successful swap. Doesn't waste a turn.

message.name: USAGE_LIMIT_ON_TURN_EXHAUSTED
message.value: Usage limit for a turn is reached!

message.name: BUNDLE.ARTHROPOD_KIT.NAME
message.value: Arthropod kit

message.name: BUNDLE.ARTHROPOD_KIT.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Crazy entomologist tried to cross the alien with insects, but soon disappeared under mysterious circumstances. The local old-timer is ready to show you their terrible secrets, but are you ready to pay for it?

message.name: BARRIERS_LAUNCHER.NAME
message.value: Barrier thrower

message.name: BARRIERS_LAUNCHER.DESCR
message.value: Gun that uses the highest available laser barriers as ammunition. Direct hit deals additional damage to target. Wastes a turn.

message.name: BARRIERS_LAUNCHER.DAMAGE
message.value: is dealt by barriers

message.name: USAGE_LIMIT_CONSUMABLES_EXHAUSTED
message.value: Exhausted limit of using consumable weapons!

message.name: ION_CANNON.NAME
message.value: Ion cannon

message.name: ION_CANNON.DESCR
message.value: The cannon requires an open space and shoots a vertical beam that delivers a concentrated charge to the selected point. Damage depends on shock bonus. The unit can't move after performing the attack!

message.name: ION_CANNON.DAMAGE
message.value: 10 hp from every hit, up to 10 hits, each hit deals damage twice

message.name: BUNDLE.SEA_KIT.NAME
message.value: Naval bundle

message.name: BUNDLE.SEA_KIT.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Our pirates hunters were able to crush the same pirate’s team several times. Though the pirate sank their ships in battle, and we didn't receive the stolen treasure, we were able to get some of their hats!

message.name: BUNDLE.PARTY_KIT.NAME
message.value: Party bundle

message.name: BUNDLE.PARTY_KIT.DESCRIPTION
message.value: At the annual diabolic ball, the most mysterious creatures of the universe gather to take a break from annoying heroes and bloody rituals. Do you want to be there too? These thingies will help you to merge with the crowd!

message.name: PUPPET_MECH.NAME
message.value: Mechanical doll

message.name: PUPPET_MECH.DESCR
message.value: The Doll is thrown like a grenade, it firmly attaches to target fighter upon hit, slowing them down, partially ignoring the slow protection. Increases carrier's shock damage by 20%, while reducing the shock protection by 100% (but not less than 0). To remove the Doll, the fighter must deal or receive a total of 500 shock damage – though they still keep slowing debuff. Victim takes 20 hp additional damage upon receiving or dealing shock damage.

message.name: PUPPET_MECH.DAMAGE
message.value: 20 hp on hit and destruction, another 20 hp on each incoming or outgoing shock attack

message.name: ELECTRO_BUOY.NAME
message.value: Electric buoy

message.name: ELECTRO_BUOY.DESCR
message.value: Floats in water for 5 effective turns (when it deals damage). Deals shock damage in radius every turn, and also blocks Frost stasis, Drill, and Pneumatic drill for 1 turn.

message.name: ELECTRO_BUOY.DAMAGE
message.value: 50 hp

message.name: ELECTRO_BUOY.HINT
message.value: Electric buoy is a great tool against enemies hiding under water! Just throw it into the water next to your target!

message.name: POISON_BOBBER.NAME
message.value: Poisonous bobber

message.name: POISON_BOBBER.DESCR
message.value: Floats in water for 5 effective turns (when it deals damage). Deals poison damage to all units in the water each turn.

message.name: POISON_BOBBER.DAMAGE
message.value: 50 hp

message.name: POISON_BOBBER.HINT
message.value: Throw it into water to chase away local inhabitants!

message.name: BUNDLE.SOUL_DESTROYER_KIT.NAME
message.value: Sherwood kit

message.name: BUNDLE.SOUL_DESTROYER_KIT.DESCRIPTION
message.value: A considerable number of legends have grown around the story of the Sherwood Robber. Many people thought that their secret is just a stroke of luck but among the coterie, it is bruited about their tackle that holds spells. He sunk into Oblivion a long time ago, but their hat and bow are still waiting for a new hero!

message.name: BUNDLE.PULSAR_KIT.NAME
message.value: Rabbit Hunter

message.name: BUNDLE.PULSAR_KIT.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Who runs after two hares will catch neither. Although no, he catches one. But the chase has to be paid, hasn't it?

message.name: BUNDLE.DRAGON_STAFF_KIT.NAME
message.value: Awesome kit

message.name: BUNDLE.DRAGON_STAFF_KIT.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Wisdom of the past and technology of the future together will delight any... dragon! Buy the kit and BLAST OFF!

message.name: BUNDLE.NEUROMANCER_KIT.NAME
message.value: Fantastic kit

message.name: BUNDLE.NEUROMANCER_KIT.DESCRIPTION
message.value: In the distant future, an ill-starred cyber-thief snatched a whole case of kits and bits from spacecraft. But, while getting away from the chase, he used a teleport and one-use time machine the other way round in a hurry... All of these ill-gotten gains are hardly useful in our time, but he can't sell gizmos from the future for next to nothing, can he?

message.name: BUNDLE.GRIM_REAPER_KIT.NAME
message.value: Grim bundle

message.name: BUNDLE.GRIM_REAPER_KIT.DESCRIPTION
message.value: You would be horrified to witness that dismal spot where your own shadow is ready to pierce your back with a knife! Fortunately: I got it, just as we agreed. Pay and receive the stuff right away. Otherwise, I can't guarantee I won't sell it to other customers. And then you'll remember me because the grim reaper will knock on your door for your soul...

message.name: BUNDLE.INQUISITOR_KIT.NAME
message.value: Infernal kit

message.name: BUNDLE.INQUISITOR_KIT.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Demons of fire and disaster have dwelt in these relics since Adam was a boy. A strong will and a modest offering – such is the price of magic of destruction.

message.name: BUNDLE.SPYGLASS_KIT.NAME
message.value: Pirate kit

message.name: BUNDLE.SPYGLASS_KIT.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Ay caramba! Ten doubloons for the hat of the dead captain? He must have had one too many rums on board...

message.name: PROMPT.ANTI_HEAL_BONUS
message.value: This character dealt more than 200 damage per turn. The victim's healing was reduced by percentage specified in the value of Ruinousness parameter!

dictionary.message: The Death Grip finishes off afflicted characters if their health is below the value specified in Death Grip parameter!
An allied unit of this character has died. The Shock power of current carrier is increased by percentage specified in Inverter parameter value!

message.name: PAPER_SQUADRON.NAME
message.value: Paper squadron

message.name: PAPER_SQUADRON.DESCR
message.value: New generation aviation: a squadron of paper airplanes automatically flies along a trajectory that is set by 4 marks when fired. The further it flies, the harder it hits the enemy. Time between launch of the first airplane and destruction of the last one is limited to 15 seconds.

message.name: PAPER_SQUADRON.DAMAGE
message.value: 6 airplanes, from 10 hp to 35 hp each, based on distance travelled

message.name: PAPER_SQUADRON.HINT
message.value: Paper airplanes fly towards the victim along a laid out path. And the further they fly, the stronger they become! Double-click the mouse or press the Spacebar to place 4 marks along which the squadron will fly and fire a shot.

dictionary.message: For every {value} damage this fighter takes, the attacker is poisoned for 1 turn. It works between turns: each enemy has its own damage counter, and the re-poison ignores the target's poison resistance.

message.name: BUNDLE.UNDERWORLD_KIT.NAME
message.value: Underworld kit

message.name: BUNDLE.UNDERWORLD_KIT.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Long ago, criminal gangs eagerly worked with an order of assassins. Now, all that remains of their former power is a crate stuffed with weapons, evidence, and other suspicious junk. Some would call it trash; others, a relic of the past. But what difference does it make when there is always someone willing to buy it?

message.name: CARPET_STRIKE.NOTE
message.value: Use left/right keys to specify the direction, where the cats should be thrown.
